Definition
[Polyconvex Lagrangian] 1. ch8:8.2.4-def-3\group Existence of Minimizers A Lagrangian $L$ is polyconvex if \[ L(P,z,x)=F(P,\det P,z,x) \tag {51} \] for a smooth $F:\mathbb M^{n\times n}\times \R \times \R ^n\times \overline U\to \R $ such that, for each fixed $(z,x)$, the joint mapping \[ (P,r)\longmapsto F(P,r,z,x) \tag {52} \] is convex.
